title: Your undone asks, each one checked

chat.text: 620 asks are recorded as undone. Forty small Haiku checks are looking each one up in the repo, and each must show the file it found or the places it searched. Started 2026-10-17; the numbers (found built, confirmed missing, unclear) land here when the checks finish.

message.text: Landed. All 620 undone asks were checked against the repo: 229 verified undone, 240 already built (nothing recorded them), 151 unclear. Ten spot-checked verdicts were all right. [Undone asks](/framework/ai/asks/undone/) now has filter chips and evidence links per row; the numbers and the ten oldest verified-undone asks are in the [verdict doc](/framework/ai/doc/undone-asks-2026-10-17.md). Cost about $25 against the $12 budget (a fixed overhead per Haiku run). I reviewed the diff myself instead of spawning a reviewer.
